name: @arcade-cabinet/persistence-drizzle
description: A typed Drizzle ORM layer for arcade-cabinet games, composed over @arcade-cabinet/persistence-save's one SQLite connection (Capacitor SQLite on native, jeep-sqlite on the web) and node:sqlite in Node tests: drizzle-kit migrations run at startup, serialized writes and transactions, a lock shared with persistence-save's snapshot saves, typed Preferences, and a hardened save envelope for export and import. Extracted from the Drizzle-over-Capacitor clients in grailguard, concrete-vermin, kings-road and a-good-old-fashioned-adventure.

scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run smoke:consumer
